raw_segments.text: Two doors from one corner, on the left hand going east the line was broken by the entry
of a court, and just at that point a certain sinister block of building thrust forward
It was two stories high, showed no window, nothing but a door on the lower story and
a blind forehead of discolored wall on the upper, and bore in every feature the marks
The door, which was equipped with neither bell nor knocker, was blistered and disdained.
Tramps slouched into the recess and struck matches on the panels.
Children kept shop upon the steps.
The schoolboy had tried his knife on the moldings, and for close on a generation, no one had
appeared to drive away these random visitors or to repair their ravages.
